Definition: from G2329; to heat (oneself):--(be) warm(-ed, self).
BiblicalUsage: thermaínō is the word the Bible uses when it means to warm oneself. In Mark 14:54, warmed himself at the fire, and it appears again in John 18:18. In the Greek text the word is spelled θερμαίνομαι.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe warming myself by another’s fire is a small picture of how easily I drift from Christ.
